reviews.comment:
Fui a cargar nafta hoy, le pedí que me cargara $30.000 de infinia! Cuando me cobra había cargado $95.000 !!!!!!! Le dije de todo al playero, porque obviamente fue adrede, su nombre es LUCAS VALERIANO ! Se la llevó barata xq yo estaba muy apurada, con mi hijo menor esperándome para llevarlo al médico xq sino me quedaba a armarle un escándalo que no le iban a quedarle ganas de joder a nadie más !!!!!! NO VUELVO MÁS

(Translated by Google)
I went to get gas today, and I asked for $30,000 worth of Infinia! When he rang me up, he'd put in $95,000 worth! I gave the attendant a piece of my mind because it was obviously on purpose. His name is Lucas Valeriano! He got off easy because I was in a huge hurry, with my youngest son waiting to take him to the doctor. Otherwise, I would have made such a scene that he wouldn't want to bother anyone else! I'M NEVER GOING BACK!
